summary: Focused verification of P1 feature: Export Journaux (CSV + PDF) with date selector. 7/7 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright downloaded both CSV (with BOM, French decimals, TOTAL row) and PDF (%PDF magic) as syndic_beta on /journals, and narrow date range 1999 correctly returned only TOTAL row with 0,00.

issues: Date inputs use browser-default picker (placeholder 'mm/dd/yyyy') instead of a French-formatted shadcn Calendar component. On a French app, dd/mm/yyyy or a shadcn date picker would be more consistent.

Multiple sequential modals block the user: T&C (legal-acceptance-modal) → 'Nouveautes NextGe Copro' release notes → 'Bienvenue! Configurez votre cabinet syndic' onboarding wizard → cookie banner. This is not a blocker but automation had to dismiss 3+ modals to reach /journals. Consider consolidating.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native date inputs on JournalsPage with a French-locale shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: exports.py _build_journal_query: correctly enforces syndic_id + copropriete_id scope. When syndic has empty allowed list it falls back to '__no_scope__' sentinel — good defensive default.
CSV writer: BOM + ';' delimiter + French decimal comma via .replace('.', ',') is correct for Excel FR. TOTAL row added; header labels match spec.
Chinese-wall middleware in server.py returns 403 before route logic — verified with alpha attempting Beta's ACP.

Frontend downloadJournalsExport uses responseType:'blob' + explicit MIME creation — matches expected behavior. Filename is built client-side; the backend-generated Content-Disposition filename is ignored (minor: could be reused for consistency).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (E2E flow: CSV download, PDF download, narrow date filter empty result)

test_credentials: syndic_beta@copro.be / Syndic123! ; syndic_alpha@copro.be / Syndic123! ; admin@copro.be / admin123
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded ACP 778391ef (Beta) AC entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend automation must dismiss 3 modals in sequence after login: (1) [data-testid=legal-accept-cgu] + [data-testid=legal-accept-privacy] + [data-testid=legal-accept-submit-btn], (2) release-notes button 'OK, j'ai compris' (curly apostrophe — use text-is selector or partial match), (3) syndic onboarding wizard 'Bienvenue!' — close via [role=dialog] button with lucide-x icon. Cookie banner is non-blocking. Then navigate to /journals (route is /journals, NOT /journaux). Export buttons are data-testid='export-journals-csv-btn' and 'export-journals-pdf-btn'. Date-filter inputs: filter-date-from / filter-date-to.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works as designed. Only minor UX observation: French app uses browser-default date picker.
